description: This file defines the 'ReadingGoal' entity class for a book tracking application. It includes properties like target (number of pages or books), goalType (enum with values PAGES or BOOKS), and related annotations for persistence, validation, and code generation. It also contains constructors, equals, hashCode, and a nested enum class.
